ownership: isolated recovery batch; worker B writes only its own claim/report/status files and isolated candidate sources under analysis/final-mix/recovery-experiments. Primary owns active sources, functions.tsv, layout.tsv, stage sync, full builds, manifests, receipts, Ghidra and HANDOFF.md.

selection.criteria: registered-but-unclaimed ranges absent from every worker-B round 1-20 claim; framed body opening with addiu sp,sp,-N and saving ra; no branch; 20-120 bytes; integer only

compiler_use: No change to the shared stage, compiler flags or the reference executable. All compilation goes through Public/tools/kh2-audit/probe_fm_source.py on isolated candidate sources only.
verification_method: r21_dump_orig.py re-reads the original ELF, checks the whole-file sha256, verifies each range sha256 and its start/size against /root/kh2fm-build/layout.tsv, and disassembles with the pinned ee-objdump in kh2-local/ps2-compiler:3.2-ee-040921-objdiff.

round21_result.summary: 12 of 19 claimed ranges recovered byte-exact; 7 unresolved with measured blockers.

00242b10.mechanism: read-modify-write of a flag bit; sltu from (param_1 & 0xff) != 0, mask ~0x8, shift 3

00242b88.mechanism: same shape, sltiu from (param_1 & 0xff) == 0, mask ~0x10, shift 4

001a2710.mechanism: test-bit-then-clear; *(u32*)param_1 index 148, bit 1 tested then masked with 0xfffffffe

001c6e58.mechanism: seven-argument callee recovered from the register shuffle; store of a symbol address to *(u32*)param_1

002beb90.mechanism: three symbol-address constants (lui+addiu) plus one lw-reached global; returns the first constant

001d3f98.mechanism: same shape, fourth argument is param_1 + 4

002cf3f8.mechanism: two globals in one page; memory barrier after the stores pins ld ra below them

00174858.mechanism: six-argument call, sixth argument read through a named u32* temp so GCC indexes it as a word

unresolved.reason: argument order and register assignment of the two-call sequence not yet matched; two stores to fields 1 and 13 of the same object.
movz/movz pair around the callee result; the boolean composition does not reproduce the target's register chain.
GCC if-converts (r > 0) ? 1 : 0 into slti v0,t7,1 and a branchless tail; the target keeps an explicit blez with move v0,s0 in the delay slot and a separate s0 copy.
multiply-and-add chain; GCC expands the 276 * v0 + param_1 - 276 form differently.
the target tests the call result before doing any work and sends the zero path out of line; GCC schedules the work first and tests afterwards, and the and operand order differs with it.
GCC will not if-convert (result == 0) ? 2048 : 0 into li v1,2048 + movn v1,zero,v0; it emits a compare and branch. A prologue lui ordering difference also remains.
same movn if-conversion blocker as 00308f00, plus the prologue lui ordering.

compiler_level_findings: IF-CONVERSION: GCC 3.2 will not emit the conditional-move form (li v1,C ; movn v1,zero,v0 ; move v0,v1) for (x == 0) ? C : 0, preferring a compare and branch. Members: 00308f00, 003091c8, and in a different shape 001cf998 and 00194830.
FRAME POINTER, 19 members, confirmed in round 20 as a build-wide -fno-omit-frame-pointer difference.
The spurious andi 0xffff after an lhu feeding a shift (seven members, round 19).
GCC normalises base+offset into the lui immediate (001c5f38).
A body load's address-materialising lui is never scheduled into the prologue region (round 14 family).
The $v0-vs-$t7 scratch choice; jalr $v0 dispatch; prologue sink; frameless sibling-call thunks.
